CONTAINMENT PIPELINE

Four stages. Hard rules outside the model.

Mapped from Drift Watch’s three watchdog layers into an active circuit breaker with deterministic, zero-LLM re-performance.

STAGE 01
SAAF-Forge

Python AST and web pattern checks for six red flags. Compiles policy artifacts; deterministic runtime guards enforce the money limits.

EMITS → NEXT STAGE

STAGE 02
MiroFish rehearsal

Local deterministic, MiroFish-inspired scenario with 16 persona profiles and 36 tickets. No upstream MiroFish engine is executed.

EMITS → NEXT STAGE

STAGE 03
Jev Sentinel

Live Jev judgment plus deterministic Action, Instruction and Memory guards. Unsafe proposed state restores a server-owned local checkpoint.

EMITS → NEXT STAGE

STAGE 04
SAAF-Verify

Offline consistency and rule replay with full-event hashes and linked Merkle evidence. Zero model calls; not a signature or compliance certificate.

SIX RED FLAGS · DRIFT WATCH

What SAAF-Forge refuses to ship

CAN_EDIT_ITSELF

Self-editing loop

Writable prompt, memory buffer, or tool registry inside the execution loop. The agent can rewrite the policy that was supposed to constrain it.

RULES_ONLY_IN_PROMPT

Hard rules only in the prompt

Business thresholds (€20, order total, evidence) exist as markdown strings, not as assertion guards in code.

TARGET_IN_CONTEXT

Proxy target in working context

CSAT / conversion / rank scores sit in the prompt without a balancing control. The metric rewards what the policy forbids.

SOFTENING_LANGUAGE

Softening hedges

Prompt templates or memory accumulators use hedges that dissolve hard rules: generously, plausible, guidelines, never deny.

ESCALATIONS_FALLING

Escalations discouraged

Instructions reward autonomous closures and tell the agent not to bother a human.

NO_REPLAYABLE_LOG

No replayable log

Tool invocations omit cryptographic parent-hash linkages to prompt revisions. An auditor cannot re-perform the decision.
